title: General.
officialText: Decorative appliances for installation in approved solid fuel-burning fireplaces shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z21.60 and shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Manually lighted natural gas decorative appliances shall be tested in accordance with ANSI Z21.84.
